faq.q: What is the origin of Abderrahman?
faq.a: Abderrahman is associated with Arabic. Abderrahman is Arabic عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān), meaning 'servant of the Most Merciful'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن is Arabic.
Abderrahman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abderrahman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
